summary: Important: nodejs:24 security, bug fix, and enhancement update
details:
Node.js is a software development platform for building fast and scalable network applications in the JavaScript programming language. 

Security Fix(es):

* ip-address: ip-address: Denial of Service via unbounded IPv6 address parsing (CVE-2026-101911)

* brace-expansion: brace-expansion: Denial of Service via uncontrolled recursion in nested brace patterns (CVE-2026-102278)

* brace-expansion: brace-expansion: Denial of Service via crafted brace patterns (CVE-2026-102277)

* brace-expansion: brace-expansion: Denial of Service via stack exhaustion from crafted brace patterns (CVE-2026-102276)

* brotli: Out-of-Bounds Write in Google Brotli Decoder (CVE-2026-111497)

* nodejs: nodejs: TLS certificate hostname bypass via fullwidth-digit IP hostnames (CVE-2026-105483)

* nodejs: nodejs: TLS certificate hostname bypass via non-canonical IP hostnames (CVE-2026-106069)

* nodejs: nodejs: dns.resolve truncates hostnames containing a NUL character (CVE-2026-105482)

* nodejs: nodejs: predictable random values via snapshot entropy cache reuse (CVE-2026-106074)

* nodejs: nodejs: Permission model bypass via wildcard path matching flaw (CVE-2026-106071)

* nodejs: nodejs: Response desynchronization via improper HTTP keep-alive connection reuse (CVE-2026-105481)

* nodejs: Node.js: Filesystem read permission bypass via fs.realpathSync() (CVE-2026-106073)

* nodejs: nodejs: Authentication bypass via non-canonical IPv4 hostname verification (CVE-2026-106072)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* nodejs:24/nodejs: Rebase to the latest Node.js 24 release [rhel-9.8.z] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-293233)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
